name: tag-picker
title: Tag picker
description: Pick tags from a pool, and each one flies into the box and back out when removed.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled ids of the picked tags, in the order they were picked.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty box before anything is picked.

a11y.text: Every tag in the pool and every remove button is a native button, so Tab, Enter and Space pick and remove.

The picker is a group labelled by label (default Tags). The picked tags are a list labelled Picked and the pool a list labelled Available. Each remove button is named Remove <tag label>, and its icon is aria-hidden. The empty box shows placeholder text.
The picker is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the flight between the lists.
